import sys
from collections import defaultdict

input = sys.stdin.read().splitlines()
N = int(input[0])
categories = {}
index = 1

for _ in range(N):
    line = input[index].split()
    category_name = line[0]
    W = int(line[1])
    words = set(line[2:])
    categories[category_name] = words
    index += 1

problem_statement = ' '.join(input[index:])
problem_words = problem_statement.split()

word_count = defaultdict(int)
for word in problem_words:
    word_count[word] += 1

category_matches = {category: sum(word_count[word] for word in words) for category, words in categories.items()}

max_matches = max(category_matches.values())
result = [category for category, matches in category_matches.items() if matches == max_matches]

print('\n'.join(sorted(result)))
